The '''Verpine comlink''' was a type of [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] developed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] that allowed them to communicate on radio wave frequencies used by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] belonging to the [[Roche asteroid field]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
